title: Descent of homogeneous cocycles through cohomology
statement: Given an equivalence between homogeneous degree-two cocycles and explicit inhomogeneous two-cocycles compatible with degree-one boundaries, the homogeneous cohomology is equivalent to the quotient by continuous coboundaries.

proof.text: Use the topological-module homology description as algebraic kernel modulo image. The cochain equivalence carries the degree-one differential to the displayed coboundary, so it induces mutually inverse maps on the quotient; quotient induction proves well-definedness and inverse laws.
